newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian lending rate falls to 9.6 from 10.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian lending rate falls to 9.6 from 10.1 pct.

text.p: The Croatian average lending rate fell to 9.6 percent on Friday from 10.1 percent on a slightly better supply of kuna funds.
Dealers said 25 million kuna in fresh demand was met almost in full. Lenders also rolled over six million kuna old loans.
The rates ranged between 8.0 percent for insurers' money and 12 percent for term loans from commercial banks.
Some 11 million kuna were settled in overnight trade Thursday as two banks borrowed money for mandatory reserves.
The central bank kuna midrate for Saturday and Monday was weaker at 5.4945 to the dollar and slightly firmer at 3.5630 to the German mark. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
